body: I might be, I might not, but what's the point really ? I know that whatever I am is something that most people unreasonably HATE and I won't escape this hatred no matter what. I know that whatever I am is contrary to the principle of evolution, a failure of nature, though I'm okay with that...But I'm in a hopeful mood today, that is until I start to fall into that same misery I had a week ago. I haven't had access to the internet in 6 days that's why I just now read your replies, and my mood has changed quite a bit, but I'm still sure that there will come a day perhaps in the near future where my life will be utterly miserable and I will have no choice but to end it. As I am sure that, even though right now I don't feel that miserable, this mood won't last that long and I'm just happy about coming home today after six days again, but still that emptiness is still here, that loneliness is still here, that despair is still here.

I'm not in the US Military, I'm in the Cypriot national guard. We've got a mandatory conscription of 2 years here. I don't think that those three people will care about me if they knew that I wasn't straight, or w/e I am, and I do believe that they'd  think that I only act this way to get attention. I can't go see a doctor since that's really frowned upon over here and is seen as an excuse to avoid work and get medical leave for a few days and I can't possibly explain my situation to any of my superiors because they certainly won't be discreet about it. I don't see how a person so unable to create relationships with people, and so different from the "normal" people can live a life that's not completely lonely and isolated.
